artifacts.text: Pitfall: the handler checks `approval.expiresAt < now` first and returns `APPROVAL_EXPIRED` before sender/route/requester verification, leaking expiry state to untrusted callers. Correction: run all sender, route, message, and requester gates first; only if every gate passes and the stored approval is expired, return the literal `APPROVAL_EXPIRED`; all other failures map to one generic error. User copy may say "a new approval is required" but must not reference a retry button or command, and must not attribute changes to owner edits.
